title.purpose: A device's name in the list and section headings.

body.purpose: Reading text and form values, with tabular figures.

annotation.purpose: Everything written about a thing: labels, sizes, scale, time zone.

code-cell.purpose: The six characters of a claim code.

axis.purpose: The hour figures under a day strip.

code-small.purpose: The sources tree and the secrets' names beside it.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Every transition: controls' fills, a busy plate's fade, a stamp's cancel stroke.

motion.name: control

motion.name: plate-busy
motion.purpose: A plate fades to 55% while its next proof draws.

motion.name: stamp-cancel

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action that saves a form.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--blue-text, #2659b8); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--blue-text, #2659b8); color: #fff; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 580; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--blue-deep, #1f4d9f); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #2f6fd6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Button
components.description: Every other action: a hairline frame in pencil blue.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="M12 5v14"/></svg>Add a screen</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--blue-text, #2659b8); border-radius: 2px; background: #fff; color: var(--blue-text, #2659b8); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 580; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--blue-wash, #e6eefb); } .ds-btn:active { background: var(--blue-rule, #c7d8f5); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #2f6fd6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: An action that changes a device or deletes a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--red-text, #c2372d); border-radius: 2px; background: #fff; color: var(--red-text, #c2372d); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 580; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--red-wash, #fbe9e7); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #2f6fd6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: A labelled input: the label in the narrow blue annotation style above a white box.
components.css: .ds-field { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif); display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; } .ds-field > span { color: var(--blue-text, #2659b8); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-stretch: 72%; font-weight: 560; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-input { font: inherit; min-height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--blue-rule, #c7d8f5); border-radius: 2px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #1b1b19); font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--blue-gray, #5f6f8f); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--blue-edge, #9bb8eb); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #2f6fd6); outline-offset: -1px; border-color: var(--blue, #2f6fd6); }

components.name: Top bar
components.description: Wordmark, two tabs and the account, in blue on paper above a hairline rule.
components.html: AfterimageDevicesScreensAlex Example Sign out
components.css: .ds-bar { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif); display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 2rem; padding: 0 2.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--blue-rule, #c7d8f5); background: var(--paper, #f7f6f1); } .ds-wordmark { display: flex; align-items: center; color: var(--blue-text, #2659b8); font-size: 1.25rem; font-stretch: 118%; font-weight: 640; letter-spacing: -0.015em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-place { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 3.25rem; color: var(--blue-text, #2659b8); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 480; text-decoration: none; } .ds-place:hover { color: var(--blue-deep, #1f4d9f); } .ds-place[aria-current="page"] { font-weight: 640; } .ds-place[aria-current="page"]::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: auto 0 -1px; height: 2px; background: var(--blue, #2f6fd6); } .ds-account { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; margin-left: auto; color: var(--ink-soft, #4b4a45); font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-account a { color: var(--blue-text, #2659b8); }

components.name: Stamp
components.description: A device state in proofer's red; an ended state is struck through and kept.
components.html: Not checked in Nothing scheduled
components.css: .ds-stamp { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif); position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.125rem 0.4375rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--red, #e2483d); outline: 1px solid var(--red, #e2483d); outline-offset: 1.5px; color: var(--red-text, #c2372d); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-stretch: 68%; font-weight: 720; letter-spacing: 0.08em; line-height: 1.3; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-stamp[data-cancelled] { border-color: rgb(226 72 61 / 0.5); outline-color: rgb(226 72 61 / 0.5); } .ds-stamp[data-cancelled]::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -0.25rem; right: -0.25rem; top: 50%; height: 1.5px; background: var(--red-text, #c2372d); transform: rotate(-8deg); }

components.name: Proof plate
components.description: A display's image at its true pixels, with crop marks and the palette's step wedge.
components.css: .ds-proof { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif); display: grid; gap: 0.75rem; margin: 0; padding: 1.25rem; } .ds-plate { position: relative; width: 320px; aspect-ratio: 5 / 3; background: #fff; outline: 1px solid rgb(27 27 25 / 0.08); display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-empty { color: var(--blue-text, #2659b8); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-stretch: 72%; font-weight: 560; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-mark { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; } .ds-mark::before, .ds-mark::after { content: ""; position: absolute; background: var(--blue, #2f6fd6); } .ds-mark::before { width: 1px; height: 0.875rem; } .ds-mark::after { width: 0.875rem; height: 1px; } .ds-mark-tl::before { left: 0; top: -1.25rem; } .ds-mark-tl::after { top: 0; left: -1.25rem; } .ds-mark-br::before { left: calc(100% - 1px); top: calc(100% + 0.375rem); } .ds-mark-br::after { top: calc(100% - 1px); left: calc(100% + 0.375rem); } .ds-caption { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; color: var(--blue-text, #2659b8); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-stretch: 72%; font-weight: 560; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-wedge { display: inline-flex; outline: 1px solid var(--blue-rule, #c7d8f5); } .ds-wedge i { width: 0.875rem; height: 0.875rem; } .ds-scale { padding-left: 0.75rem; border-left: 1px solid var(--blue-rule, #c7d8f5); }

components.name: Day strip
components.description: A day of a playlist: each entry a named lane whose bars last as long as the entry is current.
components.html:
1. Date and time
  2. Weather
components.css: .ds-strip { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 6.5rem minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0 0.75rem; width: 420px; } .ds-names { display: grid; gap: 3px; margin: 0; padding: 5px 0; list-style: none; color: var(--blue-text, #2659b8); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-stretch: 72%; font-weight: 560; line-height: 0.8125rem; } .ds-track { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 3px; padding: 4px 0; border-block: 1px solid var(--blue-rule, #c7d8f5); } .ds-lane { position: relative; height: 0.8125rem; } .ds-lane i { position: absolute; top: 3px; bottom: 3px; background: var(--ink, #1b1b19); } .ds-track b { position: absolute; top: -5px; bottom: -5px; width: 1.5px; background: var(--blue, #2f6fd6); }

narrative.overview: Every screen a display shows is a proof before it goes to ink, and the web UI is the room where those proofs are checked. Two voices share the room and never mix. Everything a display will show is true ink on white, at its real pixels. Everything Afterimage itself says (navigation, labels, measurements, annotations) is drawn in non-repro blue, the pencil colour that a print camera does not see. A third voice, proofer's red, appears only to stamp a state or to mark an action that changes a device.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground, white sheets for anything a person fills in or a display shows.
Ink only for display content and primary text; blue for everything Afterimage says.
Red reserved for stamps and destructive actions.
One variable grotesk (Archivo), with its narrow cut for annotations, stamps and codes.
Display images at 1:1 wherever the viewport can hold them, framed with crop marks and the palette's step wedge.
Flat: no shadows, no rounded cards.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Ink belongs to what a display shows and to the primary text a person reads; blue belongs to what Afterimage says about it. A label, a measurement or a navigation item is never ink; a screen's content is never blue.

rules.name: The Red Is Earned Rule
rules.body: Red appears only on a stamp or on an action that changes a device or deletes a screen. No red for emphasis, decoration or validation hints.

rules.name: The Narrow Margin Rule
rules.body: Anything written about a thing (its label, size, scale, time zone) uses the narrow annotation style in blue; anything that is the thing uses the normal width.

rules.name: The Flat Table Rule
rules.body: Proofs lie on the table; nothing floats above it. Use a white sheet, a rule or a wash, never a shadow, to separate one thing from another.

dos: Do show a display's image at 1:1 wherever the viewport holds it, and label the scale honestly where it does not.
Do write labels, sizes, times and other annotations in the narrow blue style (0.6875rem, 560, width 72%, uppercase).
Do separate sections with a 1px Hairline Blue (#c7d8f5) rule and whitespace.
Do keep text at 4.5:1 or better: Blue Gray (#5f6f8f) is the lightest text colour on paper.
Do spell out what a destructive action does to the device before it happens, and put that action in red.
Do use lucide icons at one stroke weight; never a Unicode glyph standing in for one.
donts: Don't add shadows, rounded cards or a card grid of equal tiles.
Don't use red for anything but stamps and destructive actions (The Red Is Earned Rule).
Don't set Afterimage's own labels in ink or a display's content in blue (The Two Voices Rule).
Don't introduce a second paper or a gray surface; a thing is either paper or a white sheet.
Don't add mascots, illustrations or playful copy.
